_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. Must be built from the td-load-rrip-min-extrapolate branch (adds td_combined_dynamic_thresh + per-class extreme thresholds td_combined_dyn_instr_thr_extreme / td_combined_dyn_data_thr_extreme).
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'.
_simulations: Combined L2 dynamic-THRESHOLD experiment (the threshold analog of td_combined_dynamic_datacenter). Both classes hold their depth at the suite max (instr -48, data -32); instead of moving depth, the qualification THRESHOLDS move by fe_frac = fe_bound/(fe_bound+mem_bound) over a window: balanced -> nominal thresholds (instr 0.7 / data 0.5); front-end-dominated -> instruction threshold drops (more instructions qualify) and data is turned off (all basic); memory-dominated -> data threshold drops and instructions are turned off. Lower extreme threshold = broader protection for the dominant class. The sweep varies how far the dominant threshold drops (none=nominal i.e. deprioritize-only; mod/broad/broadest = progressively lower), plus adaptation window and band width. Compare IPC / ICACHE_MISS / DCACHE_MISS_LD vs. baseline with plot_stat_change.py.
_configurations: baseline = untouched L2. static_both = combined policy, both classes at suite max depth with nominal thresholds (reference). dyn_* = dynamic-threshold combined policy; depths fixed at suite max, thresholds move: balanced -> nominal; one-sided -> dominant class threshold lowered (broader), non-dominant turned off. Grid over window (10k/100k/1M/cumulative), band (narrow .40-.60, medium .33-.66, wide .25-.75), and extreme threshold (none=nominal, mod 0.5/0.35, broad 0.3/0.2, broadest 0.1/0.05), plus corner combos.

static_both._params: HEADLINE: instructions -48 AND data -32 together (both at their effective depth; non-zero-sum test).

dyn_thr_none._params: Dynamic threshold: 100k, band .33-.66, extreme thr=nominal (deprioritize-only). Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_thr_mod._params: Dynamic threshold: 100k, band .33-.66, moderate broadening. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_thr_broad._params: Dynamic threshold: 100k, band .33-.66, broad. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_thr_broadest._params: Dynamic threshold: 100k, band .33-.66, broadest. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_w10k_thr_mod._params: Dynamic threshold: 10k window (fast), moderate. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_w1m_thr_mod._params: Dynamic threshold: 1M window (slow), moderate. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_cumulative_thr_mod._params: Dynamic threshold: cumulative (window 0), moderate. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_band_narrow_thr_mod._params: Dynamic threshold: 100k, narrow band, moderate. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_band_wide_thr_mod._params: Dynamic threshold: 100k, wide band, moderate. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_w10k_thr_broad._params: Dynamic threshold: 10k window (fast), broad. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_w10k_thr_broadest._params: Dynamic threshold: 10k window (fast), broadest. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_w1m_thr_broad._params: Dynamic threshold: 1M window (slow), broad. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_band_narrow_thr_broad._params: Dynamic threshold: 100k, narrow band, broad. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_band_wide_thr_broadest._params: Dynamic threshold: 100k, wide band, broadest. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

dyn_w10k_band_narrow_thr_mod._params: Dynamic threshold: 10k + narrow band (most aggressive), moderate. Depths fixed at suite max; balanced thr = nominal (0.7/0.5).

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Visualization settings for ./sci --visualize. Configure baseline and counters.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
